mapper.sql: SELECT i.identity_id, i.user_id, i.link_status, i.app_id, i.subject_id, (SELECT MAX(b.binding_request_id) FROM auth_binding_request b WHERE b.identity_id=i.identity_id AND b.staff_user_id=i.user_id AND b.status='VERIFIED') AS binding_id, (SELECT u.auth_version FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=i.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0') AS auth_version FROM sys_external_identity i WHERE i.provider='WECHAT'

SELECT b.binding_request_id, b.identity_id, b.staff_user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, b.status, b.reason, b.version FROM auth_binding_request b JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.staff_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_external_identity(provider,app_id,subject_id,link_status,created_at) VALUES ('WECHAT',#{appId},#{openId},'VISITOR',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE identity_id=identity_id
mapper.select: WHERE b.identity_id=#{identityId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.binding_request_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT binding_request_id FROM auth_binding_request WHERE identity_id=#{identityId} AND staff_user_id=#{staffId} AND status='VERIFIED' ORDER BY binding_request_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{id} AND status='0' AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE

JOIN sys_external_identity i ON i.identity_id=b.identity_id AND i.provider='WECHAT' WHERE b.binding_request_id < #{before} AND ( (b.status='PENDING' AND i.link_status='PENDING') OR (b.status='VERIFIED' AND i.link_status='VERIFIED' AND i.user_id=b.staff_user_id AND b.binding_request_id=(SELECT MAX(p.binding_request_id) FROM auth_binding_request p WHERE p.identity_id=b.identity_id AND p.staff_user_id=b.staff_user_id AND p.status='VERIFIED')))
AND u.dept_id IN
#{department}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY b.binding_request_id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_idempotency(scope_key,action_code,idempotency_key,payload_hash,created_at) VALUES (#{scope},#{action},#{key},#{hash},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE command_id=command_id
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,payload_hash,result_json FROM channel_idempotency WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND action_code=#{action} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
